description: Font character width table discovered at ROM offset 0x53E5B4. 256 entries of u8 values mapping ASCII characters to pixel widths.

fields.name: char_width
fields.description: Character width in pixels (0 = not rendered, 6 = standard, 13 = wide, 15 = extra wide)

notes: Font character width table for text rendering. Maps ASCII character codes (0-255) to pixel widths. Key values: space(0x20)=0, digits(0x30-0x39)=6px, lowercase(0x61-0x7A)=13px, uppercase(0x41-0x5A)=0 (not used?), punctuation varies (6-17px). Used by dialogue and menu text rendering code to calculate line breaks and text positioning.
verification_method: Static analysis - found 256-byte table with plausible character width values. Digits have uniform width (6px), lowercase letters have uniform width (13px), space has width 0. Pattern consistent with fixed-width font rendering.
discovered_by: Searching for character width tables in 4-24 pixel range
